title: The bulk deactivation confirmation shows its three lines in order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two active parts for this test, part A and part B.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  3. Click Deactivate parts.
  4. Click the part A row.
  5. Click the part B row.
  6. Click Deactivate on the dark bar.
  7. Click Cancel in the confirmation.
  8. Click the part B row.
  9. Click Deactivate on the dark bar.
  10. Click Cancel in the confirmation.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • Bulk mode turns on.

Step 4:

  • The bar reads 1 selected.

Step 5:

  • The bar reads 2 selected.

Step 6:

  • Under "2 parts selected." the confirmation reads, in this order: "These parts won't show up when adding parts to work orders, estimates, part sales or purchase orders.", "Existing records that use them stay as they are." and "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected."

Step 7:

  • The confirmation closes.

Step 8:

  • The bar reads 1 selected.

Step 9:

  • With one part the lines read: "This part won't show up when adding parts to work orders, estimates, part sales or purchase orders.", "Existing records that use it stay as they are." and "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected."

Step 10:

  • The confirmation closes and nothing changed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S10-R5: “For a deactivation from the bulk bar, the confirmation then states, in this order: "These parts won't show up when adding parts to work orders, estimates, part sales or purchase orders.", "Existing records that use them stay as they are.", and "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected." With exactly one part ticked, the lines read "This part won't show up ..." and "Existing records that use it stay as they are."”
